Hymn 151: We Meet, Dear Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: George Manwaring
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 151 titled "We Meet, Dear Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
